description: Get the full nutrient profile for one food by FDC ID. Returns all available nutrients (or a filtered subset via the nutrients[] param) with optional per-portion scaling. Use usda_search_foods to discover FDC IDs. Values are per 100 g (basisUnit "g"), except Branded foods FDC reports per 100 ml (basisUnit "ml") or per 100 of a label unit that fixes neither (basisUnit absent, basis unverified). Provide unit, optionally with quantity, to scale all nutrient values from that basis to that amount (e.g. quantity=200, unit="g" → per-200g values); a mass unit is applied to an ml or label-unit basis without conversion, and a notice says so. quantity defaults to 100 for g, oz, lb, and kg and to 1 for serving. Serving uses the first valid portion, or a positive finite Branded label size in g/GRM/GM (case-insensitive) when no portion exists; quantity multiplies that weight. A label in any other unit sets the basis rather than a serving weight, so it requires an explicit mass-unit request. quantity without unit is rejected. Narrow nutrients[] to specific IDs to reduce response size for focused queries.

fdcId.description: FDC ID of the food. Use usda_search_foods to discover IDs.

nutrients.description: Filter to specific nutrient IDs (e.g. [1003, 1004, 1005, 1008] for protein, fat, carbs, energy). Use usda_list_nutrients to look up IDs. Omit to return all available nutrients. Requested IDs the food does not report are listed in missingNutrients.

quantity.description: Amount of food, in unit, to scale nutrient values to. Must be positive. Requires unit. Defaults to 100 when unit is g, oz, lb, or kg, and to 1 when unit is "serving". Omit both quantity and unit for the per-100 values FDC reports (per 100 g, or per 100 ml when basisUnit is "ml").

unit.description: Unit for quantity. "serving" uses the first valid portion weight, or a Branded label size in g/GRM/GM (case-insensitive) when no portion exists, multiplied by quantity. Required when quantity is provided. Given alone, scales to 100 g, oz, lb, or kg, or to 1 serving.

name: usda_get_food

allPortions.description: All named portions for this food, in FDC order.

items.description: A named portion for this food.

amount.description: How many of the described unit gramWeight covers (0.5 for "0.5 cup"), when FDC sends one. Absent for Survey (FNDDS) portions, whose description carries the amount.

basisUnit.description: What the per-100 nutrient values are measured in: "g" for every non-Branded food and for Branded labels in g/GRM/GM, "ml" for Branded labels in ml/MLT. Absent when the label unit (e.g. IU, MG) fixes neither, so the basis is unverified.

dataType.description: FDC data source: SR Legacy, Foundation, Survey (FNDDS), or Branded.

description.description: Full USDA food name (e.g. "Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, raw").

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The FDC ID does not exist in the database. `quantity_without_unit`: quantity is provided but unit is omitted. `no_portion_data`: unit="serving" was requested but the food has no valid portion or supported Branded gram-label serving. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

foodCategory.description: USDA food category (e.g. "Poultry Products"): the food category for SR Legacy and Foundation, the label category for Branded, the WWEIA category for Survey (FNDDS). Absent when FDC reports none.

gtinUpc.description: GTIN/UPC barcode as FDC stores it, leading zeros kept (e.g. "011110044174"). Branded items only.

householdServingFullText.description: Serving as the label words it (e.g. "1 cup"). Branded items only.

ingredients.description: Ingredient list from label. Branded items only.

missingNutrients.description: Requested nutrient IDs this food's profile does not report, deduplicated, in request order. Absent when nutrients[] was omitted or every requested ID is present.

notice.description: Basis caveat when a food not reported per 100 g is scaled: the resolved amount was applied to its per-100 ml or unverified label-unit basis without conversion.

nutrients.description: Nutrient values for this food, per 100 of basisUnit or scaled to the scaledTo basis.

items.description: A single nutrient entry with ID, name, amount, and unit.

amount.description: Nutrient amount — per 100 of basisUnit, or per scaledTo.gramWeight when unit is provided.

percentDailyValue.description: Percent daily value from product label. Branded items only.

publicationDate.description: Date this food entry was published in FDC.

scaledTo.description: Scaling basis when unit was provided. Absent when returning per-100 values.

gramWeight.description: Amount resolved from quantity and unit (for serving, quantity × servingInfo.gramWeight); all nutrient values are per this many grams. With basisUnit "ml" it is applied as millilitres, and with no basisUnit as label units, without conversion.

quantity.description: Quantity applied — the requested value, or the default for unit (100 for g, oz, lb, kg; 1 for serving).

unit.description: Unit provided in the request (g, oz, lb, kg, or serving).

servingInfo.description: First available portion definition, or a Branded gram-label serving identified in its description.

amount.description: How many of the described unit gramWeight covers (0.5 for "0.5 cup"), when FDC sends one. Absent for Survey (FNDDS) portions, whose description carries the amount, and for a label serving.

description.description: Portion description: the Survey (FNDDS) portion text, or the amount, measure unit, and modifier (e.g. "0.5 cup"); for a Branded gram label, "Label serving:" with its size, unit, and household text.

servingSize.description: Serving size from the product label, in servingSizeUnit. Branded items only.

servingSizeUnit.description: Unit for servingSize as FDC reports it (e.g. "GRM", "MLT", "IU"); it sets basisUnit. Branded items only.

title: Get USDA Food
